html:
Researchers at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign tested a range of face masks to see how they change the sound of the wearer’s voice. This video from the lab analyzes how strongly each mask absorbs sound at different frequencies and how much it hides the mouth and facial expressions, both of which affect how intelligible speech is.

The researchers also suggest ways of enhancing speech so that masked speakers are easier to understand.

Video: Innovation in Augmented Listening Technology, University of Illinois; shared by Fanyu Meng on Ziyu Acoustics. The lab describes the study at How do face masks affect speech?
